english_draft: SK hynix reported Q3 2025 K-IFRS revenue of KRW 24.4489tn, operating profit KRW 11.3834tn, net profit KRW 12.5975tn, per its official IR release. Operating margin was 47%. The company attributed record performance to 12-high HBM3E and server DDR5. No same-period Preview is available. This draft contains only company-reported figures and no consensus, market reaction, or segment estimates.
